name: Microsoft Teams
description: Microsoft Teams organizes workplace collaboration into teams and channels backed by Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Graph.
agentUseSummary: Connect one work or school account through Relay-owned Microsoft OAuth with OIDC, offline refresh, PKCE, and only delegated Team.ReadBasic.All plus Channel.ReadBasic.All. Four wrappers read up to twenty-five directly joined teams, one explicit team, up to twenty-five visible channels in one explicit team, or one explicit channel. Relay blocks messages and chats, rosters and directory data, files and meetings, writes, application and admin authority, metered APIs, exports, raw endpoints, automatic pagination, and retries.

capabilities.label: Inspect a team
capabilities.description: Read one explicit team's useful metadata.

capabilities.label: List visible channels
capabilities.description: Read visible channel metadata in one explicit team.

capabilities.label: Inspect a channel
capabilities.description: Read one explicit channel's useful metadata.

allowed.label: List joined teams
allowed.description: Read up to twenty-five teams where the signed-in work user is a direct member.

allowed.label: Get team
allowed.description: Read useful metadata for one explicit prior-result team.

allowed.label: List team channels
allowed.description: Read up to twenty-five channels visible to the signed-in user in one explicit team.

allowed.label: Get team channel
allowed.description: Read useful metadata for one explicit prior-result channel in one explicit team.

blocked.label: Read messages or chats
blocked.description: Channel messages, replies, private chats, bodies, senders, reactions, search, subscriptions, and metered export APIs are blocked.

blocked.label: Read members or directory
blocked.description: Members, owners, rosters, profiles, email addresses, users, groups, and directory data are blocked.

blocked.label: Access other Teams workloads
blocked.description: Files, tabs, apps, meetings, calls, recordings, transcripts, calendars, and other Microsoft Graph workloads are blocked.

blocked.label: Mutate or administer Teams
blocked.description: Team/channel/message mutations, sends, application permissions, RSC, admin scopes, tenant enumeration, and consent management are blocked.

blocked.label: Export or use raw Graph
blocked.description: Exports, delta, arbitrary queries, raw endpoints, beta Graph, automatic pagination, polling, retries, and CLI or MCP passthrough are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Read only
approvalProfiles.description: Four delegated work-account team/channel metadata reads run automatically; messages, rosters, other workloads, writes, admin authority, metered APIs, raw access, and pagination remain blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The exact delegated scopes, work-account boundary, four typed metadata reads, first-page-only behavior, privacy exclusions, and no-write invariants remain enforced.

Those provider-console and environment actions are outside this worker task.
providerSetup.nextAction: In the provider-console task, configure the canonical callback and exact delegated scopes, complete publisher verification and tenant acceptance, then verify account binding, all four wrappers, refresh, rotation, revocation, disconnect, consent denial, throttling/error mapping, privacy exclusions, and post-disconnect denial.
